entities.summary: Zachary Senyshyn is a Canadian professional ice hockey forward for Vlci Žilina of the Slovak Extraliga. Senyshyn was selected by the Boston Bruins in the first round of the 2015 NHL Entry Draft. He was born in Ottawa, Ontario.
